answer: An operator joins the island by staking 40 tokens and submitting a fresh cipher signature over their unique ID. At registration, three peer verifiers check the signature. If it fails, they slash the entire deposit. If it passes, the agent earns a 3-token reward only at epoch close. Because the reward is less than the stake, any extra clone of the same identity incurs a net loss of 37 tokens per fake node. This plume of losses kills the attack.
